requirement: EPIC-3 · Story 3.2 — Lesson persistence (localStorage) + export/import JSON. The user keeps a local library of named lessons and can move a lesson between devices as a .json file. API contract (state layer): saveLesson(lesson), listLessons() -> {id,title,updatedAt}[], loadLesson(id) -> Lesson, deleteLesson(id), exportLesson(lesson) -> download a .json, importLesson(file) -> validated Lesson. Data model: localStorage — an index of {id,title,updatedAt} plus one JSON blob per lesson keyed by id; fill id (uuid) + title on save. Imported JSON MUST be validated against schemaVersion + shape before loading; a mismatch is rejected with a clear message (do not load garbage into the editor). Simple list UI (no thumbnails — that is the v1.1 Electron catalogue). The Lesson schema is the locked spine (README): { schemaVersion:1, id, title, source:{type,ref,clipStart,clipEnd}, bpm, bank:'ROK', bars:2, steps:32, layers:[{id:'drums',type:'drums',hits:[{step,sound}]},{id:'bass',type:'bass',notes:[{step,pad,octave,length}]}], teachOrder:['drums','bass'] }. step 0-31, sound in kick|snare|hat, pad in the 12 native strings, octave -2..+2. Do NOT change the schema (bump schemaVersion only if truly forced). The in-memory Pattern (src/pattern.ts) maps 1:1 onto the layers — build the conversion as the single seam both directions.

architecture.decision: No design fork — localStorage persistence and the Lesson JSON schema are both locked (README). Story 3.2 only needs (a) a serialization seam between the in-memory Pattern and the schema's layers, and (b) thin localStorage CRUD + file export/import. uuid = native crypto.randomUUID() (no dependency). Export = a Blob + object-URL anchor download; import = a file input + JSON.parse + shape validation. Self-checks are callable _selfcheck() (matching the repo's existing convention; they are not auto-invoked).
seams: src/lesson.ts owns the Lesson TypeScript type (mirroring the locked schema exactly), the conversion seam patternToLayers(pattern) <-> layersToPattern(lesson) (drums booleans <-> hits[{step,sound}]; bass (BassCell|null)[] <-> notes[{step,pad,octave,length}]), makeLesson({ pattern, bpm, title, id?, source? }) that assembles a full schema-valid Lesson (schemaVersion 1, bank 'ROK', bars 2, steps 32, teachOrder ['drums','bass'], id = passed id or crypto.randomUUID(), source default { type:'manual', ref:'', clipStart:0, clipEnd:0 }), and validateLesson(obj): { ok:true, lesson } | { ok:false, error } that checks schemaVersion===1 and the required shape (layers present, hits/notes arrays, step in 0..31, sound in kick|snare|hat, pad a valid native string, octave -2..+2) and returns a clear error string on mismatch. A _selfcheck asserts round-trip: layersToPattern(makeLesson(patternToLayers... )) reproduces the original pattern, and validateLesson rejects a bad object. This is the ONLY place Pattern<->schema conversion lives; the UI and any future pipeline import reuse it.

src/storage.ts owns localStorage CRUD keyed off lesson id: a single index key (e.g. 'sbc.lessons.index') holding {id,title,updatedAt}[] and per-lesson keys (e.g. 'sbc.lesson.<id>') holding the Lesson JSON. saveLesson(lesson) upserts both (updatedAt = Date.now()); listLessons() reads the index (sorted newest first); loadLesson(id) reads + validateLesson-checks the blob; deleteLesson(id) removes both. All wrapped so a quota/parse error surfaces, never throws uncaught. No IndexedDB.

src/LessonLibrary.tsx (+css) is the UI: a title input + Save (persists the current editor pattern/bpm as a lesson), a list of saved lessons each with Load + Delete + Export, and an Import file input. Export builds a .json download of the lesson via a Blob object URL; Import reads the chosen file, JSON.parse + validateLesson, and either loads it (rejecting a malformed file with the returned error message shown to the user) or shows the error. App owns the current pattern + bpm + current title/id and passes down the current lesson (built via makeLesson) plus onLoad(lesson) which sets pattern + bpm (+ title/id) into App state.

src/App.tsx wiring: track currentTitle + currentLessonId state; render <LessonLibrary> (in the structure pane, after the grid/inspector) fed the current pattern + bpm + title/id and an onLoad that applies a loaded Lesson to the editor (layersToPattern -> setPattern, setBpm, set title/id). Saving reuses the current id if present (update in place) else mints a new one. Loading + reload persistence must round-trip intact.

tasks.title: Lesson serialization seam + localStorage CRUD (no UI)
tasks.intent: Create src/lesson.ts and src/storage.ts. lesson.ts: (1) export a Lesson type mirroring the locked README schema EXACTLY — { schemaVersion: 1; id: string; title: string; source: { type: 'upload'|'youtube'|'manual'; ref: string; clipStart: number; clipEnd: number }; bpm: number; bank: 'ROK'; bars: number; steps: number; layers: [DrumLayer, BassLayer]; teachOrder: string[] } with DrumLayer = { id: 'drums'; type: 'drums'; hits: { step: number; sound: DrumSound }[] } and BassLayer = { id: 'bass'; type: 'bass'; notes: { step: number; pad: PadId; octave: number; length: number }[] } (reuse DrumSound/BassCell from pattern.ts and PadId from constants.ts). (2) patternToLayers(p: Pattern): [DrumLayer, BassLayer] — for each drum lane (kick/snare/hat) emit a hit {step,sound} for every true step (in step order); for bass emit a note {step,pad,octave,length} for every non-null cell. (3) layersToPattern(lesson: Lesson): Pattern — inverse: start from emptyPattern(), set each hit's lane[step]=true, set each bass note into bass[step]. Be defensive: ignore out-of-range steps. (4) makeLesson({ pattern, bpm, title, id, source }): Lesson — assemble a full schema-valid lesson: schemaVersion 1, id = id ?? crypto.randomUUID(), title, source ?? { type:'manual', ref:'', clipStart:0, clipEnd:0 }, bpm, bank 'ROK', bars 2, steps 32 (import STEPS from pattern.ts), layers = patternToLayers(pattern), teachOrder ['drums','bass']. (5) validateLesson(obj: unknown): { ok: true; lesson: Lesson } | { ok: false; error: string } — verify obj is an object with schemaVersion===1, title is a string, bpm is a finite number, layers is an array containing a drums layer with a hits array and a bass layer with a notes array, every hit has step in 0..31 and sound in {kick,snare,hat}, every note has step in 0..31, a pad in the 12 valid PAD_IDS, octave in -2..2, length a number; return a specific human-readable error string on the FIRST failure (e.g. 'Unsupported schemaVersion: 2 (expected 1)', 'Missing drums layer', 'Invalid bass pad: "9"'). (6) a _selfcheck() (callable, matching the repo convention) that: builds a non-empty Pattern, round-trips layersToPattern(<makeLesson>).equals original (assert drums + bass match), and asserts validateLesson rejects a bad object (wrong schemaVersion) with ok:false and accepts a good one. storage.ts: localStorage CRUD keyed by id — const INDEX_KEY='sbc.lessons.index'; lessonKey(id)=`sbc.lesson.${id}`. saveLesson(lesson): write lessonKey blob (JSON.stringify) and upsert the index entry { id, title, updatedAt: Date.now() } (replace existing same-id entry), index stored sorted by updatedAt desc. listLessons(): parse INDEX_KEY (return [] if absent/corrupt). loadLesson(id): read blob, JSON.parse, run validateLesson, return the Lesson or null (+console.warn on invalid/missing). deleteLesson(id): remove the blob key and the index entry. Wrap localStorage writes in try/catch so a quota error is caught and surfaced (return a boolean or throw a typed error the UI can show) — never crash the app. NO new dependency (use crypto.randomUUID + JSON + localStorage). Do NOT build any React/UI here.
tasks.constraints: Match the locked schema field-for-field — do NOT invent fields or rename; do NOT change schemaVersion (it stays 1). Reuse Pattern/emptyPattern/STEPS/DrumSound/BassCell from pattern.ts and PadId/PAD_IDS/OCTAVE_MIN/OCTAVE_MAX from constants.ts — do not redefine them. Conversion helpers are PURE. validateLesson is the trust boundary for imported files — it must be thorough (this is the security/robustness surface for 3.2) and return a clear error, never throw on bad input. crypto.randomUUID() for ids (native; no uuid dependency). localStorage access is wrapped so parse/quota errors are handled, not thrown uncaught. TypeScript strict, no unused symbols, minimal diff. Add a ponytail comment for any deliberate shortcut (e.g. index kept sorted on write rather than on read). Keep the _selfcheck pure (no localStorage, no DOM).
tasks.acceptance: npm run build passes. lesson.ts exports Lesson type, patternToLayers, layersToPattern, makeLesson, validateLesson, _selfcheck. storage.ts exports saveLesson, listLessons, loadLesson, deleteLesson. In a browser console (or a runnable check): _selfcheck() passes — a populated pattern survives pattern->lesson->pattern round-trip identically, validateLesson rejects { schemaVersion: 2 } with ok:false + a clear error and accepts a valid lesson. No new dependency added to package.json. No uncaught throw on malformed input to validateLesson/loadLesson.
tasks.visual: Browser console on the running app: import is internal, so verify via the app in T2. For T1, additionally call the module _selfcheck from devtools (or a temporary invocation) and confirm no assertion fires; confirm validateLesson({schemaVersion:2}) returns {ok:false,error:...}.
tasks.result: src/lesson.ts: Lesson type mirrors locked schema field-for-field (schemaVersion 1, bank ROK, bars 2, steps 32, teachOrder). patternToLayers/layersToPattern (defensive on out-of-range step/unknown sound), makeLesson (crypto.randomUUID, manual source default), validateLesson trust boundary — first-failure specific errors (schemaVersion, title, bpm, missing drums/bass layers + hits/notes arrays, step 0..31, sound kick|snare|hat, pad in PAD_IDS, octave ±2, length number), never throws. _selfcheck round-trips a populated pattern + rejects schemaVersion 2 & bad pad. src/storage.ts: INDEX_KEY 'sbc.lessons.index' + per-lesson 'sbc.lesson.<id>'; saveLesson (upsert index, updatedAt, sort desc, returns false on quota), listLessons, loadLesson (JSON.parse + validateLesson, null on invalid + warn), deleteLesson — every read try/catch guarded. No new dep (imports pattern/constants only, no Tone). Supervisor-verified: npm run build passes; package.json/lock unchanged; bundled _selfcheck via esbuild + ran in node -> 'SELFCHECK PASS (0 failures)' (round-trip identical, validator rejects/accepts correctly).

tasks.title: Lesson library UI — save/name, list (load/delete), export + import .json, wired into the editor
tasks.intent: Create src/LessonLibrary.tsx + src/LessonLibrary.css and wire into src/App.tsx so the user can name+save the current pattern, see a list of saved lessons, load/delete them, export a lesson to a .json file, and import a .json back. 1) App.tsx: add currentTitle (string, default '') and currentLessonId (string|null) state. Build the current lesson on demand via makeLesson({ pattern, bpm, title: currentTitle, id: currentLessonId ?? undefined }). Add onLoad(lesson: Lesson) that applies a loaded lesson to the editor: setPattern(layersToPattern(lesson)); setBpm(lesson.bpm); setCurrentTitle(lesson.title); setCurrentLessonId(lesson.id); clear selectedBassStep. Render <LessonLibrary> in the structure pane AFTER the grid + BassInspector. 2) LessonLibrary.tsx props: { currentPattern, currentBpm, title, onTitleChange, currentLessonId, onLoad }. It: (a) shows a title <input> bound to title/onTitleChange and a Save button -> saveLesson(makeLesson({ pattern: currentPattern, bpm: currentBpm, title: title || 'Untitled', id: currentLessonId ?? undefined })), then refreshes the list and (if a new id was minted) reflects it — simplest: Save calls makeLesson once, saves it, and calls onLoad(savedLesson) so App adopts the id/title. (b) lists listLessons() newest-first; each row shows the title + a Load button (loadLesson(id) -> if valid onLoad(lesson), else show its error) + a Delete button (deleteLesson(id) + refresh) + an Export button (exportLesson for that id). (c) an Import <input type=file accept=.json>: on change, read the file text, JSON.parse in a try/catch, run validateLesson; if ok call onLoad(result.lesson) (and optionally save it), else show result.error (or the parse error) in an inline, polite, visible message. Keep a local state for the last error/status message (aria-live). exportLesson(lesson): create a Blob([JSON.stringify(lesson, null, 2)], {type:'application/json'}), an object URL, a temporary <a download=`${sanitizedTitle||id}.json`> click, then revokeObjectURL. 3) LessonLibrary.css: simple stealth-themed list + controls, reuse .tbtn-style buttons and theme.css tokens; >=44px targets; the file input and title input keyboard-accessible + labeled. a11y (story 1.6 lock): every control labeled (aria-label or a <label>), keyboard-operable, status/error message in an aria-live region, contrast AA. Do NOT regress the grid editor, bass inspector, pattern playback, or transport. Reuse lesson.ts/storage.ts from T1 — add NO new persistence logic here.
tasks.constraints: Reuse T1's lesson.ts (makeLesson/layersToPattern/validateLesson) and storage.ts (saveLesson/listLessons/loadLesson/deleteLesson) — the UI holds NO schema knowledge of its own beyond calling these. Import is the trust boundary: parse + validateLesson BEFORE loading; a malformed or wrong-schemaVersion file must be REJECTED with the clear error shown to the user (never load partial/garbage into the editor, never crash). Export/import is the only cross-device sync — plain download/open, no network. a11y non-negotiable: labeled + keyboard controls, >=44px targets, aria-live status. Stealth theme + Anthropic-orange accent via theme.css; reuse .tbtn where possible; minimal bespoke CSS; minimal diff; TypeScript strict. Mark deliberate shortcuts with a ponytail comment (e.g. no rename-in-place UI; Save overwrites by current id). Guard empty states (no saved lessons yet renders a hint, not a crash).
